literal_meaning: বাজার করা বা বাজারের মতো কাজ করা
figurative_meaning_en: To create a commotion; to make noise or fuss
example_sentences_in_english: The children are making a commotion while playing.
Everyone started creating a fuss in the meeting.
note: The idiom draws from the lively, noisy atmosphere of traditional Bengali rural markets (hats).
